CA.rationale: Content (red locations) and a processing/origin condition (command_estimate/feedback) are explicitly bound for the same candidate item.

COD.rationale: For the same current item p0/current/n0 the report gives content (red set), an explicit origin/organization field, and shows the content separately from its origin/status.

A.rationale: Processing/command-estimate and conditional-execution origin metadata explicitly relate processing conditions to specific candidate contents.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifiers (color-coded location sets) are given for current and candidate items.

D.rationale: Origin/status fields are provided separately from the content listings, distinguishing identification from organization/status.

O.rationale: Explicit origin/representation metadata describe how contents are organized/presented (copied_prior_record, inherited_current, command_estimate, etc.).
